visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit bedroom where a calico cat with orange, black, and white fur is standing on a plush, light-grey textured blanket. The cat is kneading the soft fabric with its front paws in a rhythmic motion. In the background, a dark television screen and various small decorative objects on a shelf are visible under soft, low-intensity room lighting. (2) The camera angle shifts to reveal a second cat, a brown and black tabby, which is also on the blanket. This cat exhibits a mounting behavior, biting the fabric and moving its lower body rhythmically. A human hand briefly enters the frame from the bottom left to feel the thickness and softness of the grey quilt. (3) The calico cat continues its kneading behavior while the tabby cat approaches it. The tabby cat briefly licks the side of the calico cat's head. The background remains consistent with the indoor home setting, showing a clean but dark environment. (4) Both cats are eventually shown lying down peacefully on the same grey blanket, which covers a bed with a white patterned sheet. The human hand reappears to gently pet the tabby cat's head. The video ends with a close-up shot of a decorative patch on the blanket featuring a cartoon cat wearing a mushroom hat and the text 'FUMEANCATS' and 'HOYACASA'.
